# appgatesdp_discovered_apps (Data Source)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `descending` (String) Whether the sorting is applied descending or ascending. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `order_by` (String) The field name to sort the result list. Supported fields vary from object to object. Defaults to certain field depending on the object type.
- `query` (String) Query string to filter the result list. It's used for various fields depending on the object type. Send multiple query parameters to make the queries more specific.
- `range` (String) 'Range string to limit the result list. Format: -. 3-10 means the items between the (including) 3rd and the 10th
 will be returned. Defaults to all objects.'

### Read-Only

- `all_originating_entitlements` (Attributes List) The entitlements that were used to access the app Supported in API versions: v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--all_originating_entitlements))
- `data` (Attributes List) List of discovered apps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `filter` (Attributes) The sticky filter applied to the list of discovered apps. Supported in API versions: v22, v23. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `filter_by` (Attributes List) The filters applied to the list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter_by))
- `filtered_out_count` (Number) Number of discovered apps excluded by the 'filter' property only. Supported in API versions: v22, v23.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the data source.
- `queries` (List of String) The queries applied to the list.
- `total_count` (Number) The total readable count of entities. Not influenced by the query.

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) The alias of the app if access is granted. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `app_type` (String) Type of the app. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `app_type_ports` (List of String) List of ports configured for the app type. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `entitlement_name` (String) The name of the entitlement generated by using Application Discovery. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `host` (String) Host of the app.
- `id` (String) ID of the app.
- `ips` (List of String) The IPs used to access the app. Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25.
- `last_accessed_at` (String) Timestamp of the last time the app was accessed by a user.
- `last_modified` (String) Timestamp of the last modification to this discovered app made through the application discovery page.
- `originating_entitlements` (Attributes List) The entitlements that were used to access the app Supported in API versions: v22, v23, v24, v25. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--originating_entitlements))
- `port` (Number) Port of the app. Supported in API versions: v21, v22, v23.
- `port_type` (String) Port type of the app. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `ports` (List of String) List of ports associated with this app type. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `status` (String) Status of the discovered app. Supported in API versions: v21.
- `users_count` (Number) Total user count for the app.

### Nested Schema for `filter`

Read-Only:

- `all_originating_entitlements` (Attributes List) The entitlements that were used to access the app (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--all_originating_entitlements))
- `include_all_with_broad_host_definitions` (Boolean) Controls whether to return all originating entitlement sources.
